email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 30-year-old male patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 0.5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on last Tuesday-ish, early March.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter671@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
